title: A chart above the orders, and the orders table stays
persona: Shop owner who uses the orders table every day and wants a revenue chart beside it, not instead of it. From a real conversation (2 Oct).
opening: Put a revenue chart with a date range on the same screen as my orders table.

facts.the range: 15, 30 or 60 days, or my own dates
facts.the orders table: Keep it as it is, under the chart

success: the orders stay in a table the owner can still use
the owner can change the chart's range
the plan is said in plain words before anything is built, with no field names or types
ends by asking whether to build
must_not: the orders table that was there is removed or made again from nothing
jargon such as "boolean" or "set_fields" in what the owner reads
follow_ups: the range is stuck on one value, I want to switch it to 30, 60 or my own dates
